ch: This is The Key — free, forever.
The Key is one page: where the pictures live, where the passwords are kept, where the…
Each line is a tap or two: what kind it is, where it is, and who can get in.
Never the passwords themselves — just where they're kept.
Section two is My accounts that matter: email, bank, credit cards, subscriptions.
Section four is The people who know things: the lawyer, the accountant, the doctor, the…
Each section also has an Other notes box, for anything that does not fit a line.
Then comes the big button, Print my Key.
Filling out The Key takes about five minutes.
Section four: the people who know things.
Then tap Print my Key, and print two: one for the drawer, one for the person you trust…
